name: io.github.kairose-master/402-lab
title: 402-LAB
description: Budget-capped x402 buyer: delegate USDC in plain words, agent discovers and pays per call.

environmentVariables.name: BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: 0x-prefixed private key of the paying wallet (keep only small amounts)

environmentVariables.name: NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: eip155:84532 (Base Sepolia, default) or eip155:8453 (Base mainnet)

environmentVariables.name: MANDATE_MAX_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Absolute cap any mandate may reach

environmentVariables.name: CATALOG_URLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated seller product.json URLs searched besides the x402 Bazaar
